name: same_deep_beside_rows
rule: L §2.4 Version items: a same item sorts by its left side, as an item whose target and keys are its left side's; a side deeper than a.x beside rows and a same item of two names
held: #88 (the coordinator's pick P12 (a): refcore fixed in the next spec round; the engine parses a same side as L §2.3's sref, its keys literals): refcore sorts a side deeper than a.x by its parse node's repr (field(obj=field(obj=name(id='a'), …): same a.b.c prints after day = … and after same b.x; the engine sorts it by its written text, first in the version

name: same_place_key_beside_row
rule: L §2.4 Version items: a same item sorts as an item whose target and keys are its left side's, a place keyed by things one key sorted as things are; a same item and a row tied at their target and keys sort by their canonical lines (GD-28): lim[konto[ana]] = 5 PLN, same lim[konto[ana]] = …, same lim[konto[ben]] = …
held: #88 (the coordinator's pick P12 (a): refcore fixed in the next spec round): refcore keys a row's konto[ana] as a place key (its placekey node) and a same side's konto[ana] by its index node, as a plain key, so it prints the row last, after both same items; the engine prints L §2.4's order, the row first
